reason: Wrong side of Ben's market on three axes: Voldex is a Roblox UGC live-ops rollup (Brookhaven, Driving Empire, NFL Universe Football; 145-170M MAU) whose games run on Roblox's own infrastructure in Lua, not a US PC/console studio entering full production with an Unreal/Unity build pipeline and a publisher-fixed milestone date; it is Voldex Entertainment Ltd., HQ London (CB Insights; BusinessWire dateline LONDON) with staff distributed across 17 countries, not US-based; and every shipped title is already live and revenue-generating, so Ben's EDP (runway burned against a milestone that gates a funding tranche) does not exist here. The one ops-flavored posting, Security & IT Specialist, is device/access/internal-tool management for a remote-first company - precisely the 'generic MSP' work Ben's own NOT-list excludes - and they are hiring a full-time owner for it directly rather than lacking one at the leadership layer.
